items.name: Vocalizer Pro
items.description: Sovereign Real-Time Vocal Processing Suite reverse-engineered from VST3. Features dynamic pitch tracking & autotune, 4-voice polyphonic harmonizer, 6-band parametric EQ, noise gate, de-esser, compressor, saturation, chorus/modulation, ducking delay, and studio reverb with interactive SVG 706x532 UI.

items.name: Kamidi Mastering Console Pro
items.description: Professional 32-bit float audio mastering console with Parametric EQ, Multiband Compressor, Brickwall Limiter, Transient Shaper, Sub Bass 808 saturation, and Dual-Pass EBU R128 LUFS metering.

items.name: LUFS Meter Pro Studio
items.description: Professional LUFS Meter, Audio Mastering, True Peak & Loudness Compliance Studio for Spotify, Apple, YouTube, and Broadcast.

items.name: Vocal & Stem Demixer Studio
items.description: Sovereign AI audio stem separation and vocal remover studio powered by Meta AI Demucs v4 (Hybrid Transformer HTDemucs). Extract isolated vocals (acapella), instrumental (karaoke), drums, bass, and multitrack stems with hardware GPU CUDA acceleration.

items.name: Audio-to-MIDI Neural Studio
items.description: Sovereign high-fidelity neural polyphonic audio-to-MIDI transcription studio powered by Spotify Basic Pitch ONNX engine. Extract pitch bends, notes, and velocity from any audio format with interactive Canvas Piano Roll visualizer.
